21. CONNECT TAIL PIPE AND FRONT PIPE
(a) Connect the pipe to the tail pipe.
(b) Install the two rubber hangers.
(c) Install the pipe clamp to the transmission case.
Torque: 440 kg-cm (32 ft-lb, 43 N-m)

22. INSTALL INTERMEDIATE PROPELLER SHAFT

23. CONNECT WIRING CONNECTORS TO NEUTRAL START AND BACK-UP LIGHT SWITCHES

24. CONNECT TRANSMISSION THROTTLE CABLE
(a) Connect the cable to the throttle linkage.
(b) Connect the cable housing to the bracket.

25. ADJUST TRANSMISSION THROTTLE CABLE

26. CONNECT UPPER RADIATOR HOSE AND FILL WITH COOLANT

27. CONNECT BATTERY CABLE TO NEGATIVE (−) TERMINAL

0-1 mm (0-0.04 in.)
